headline: Paraguay police detain brother of former president Santiago Peña over Ueno Bank scandal
summary: Prosecutors ordered the arrest of Francisco Peña Palacios, brother of former president Santiago Peña, in connection with the Ueno Bank scandal. Police intercepted him at his Asunción home.
why: Ueno Bank is a Paraguayan lender, and scandals at banks can affect depositor confidence and regulatory scrutiny of the sector.
original_headline: Policía de Paguay detiene al hermano del expresidente Santiago Peña por escándalo de Ueno Bank
